constants.name: pendulum_cl_ic_bound
constants.why: bound of the uniform closed-loop initial states for the pendulum (SYS pendulum cl_ic in method/run.py)

constants.name: lqr_input_weight

constants.name: sindy_default_lambda

constants.name: mlp_weight_decay

constants.name: mlp_batch_size

constants.name: mlp_gradient_steps
